text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Would you care to show me that color?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...How lovely, the color of the night.
I'll take that eyeshadow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tonight, Mejiro Ramonu is scheduled
to run in an exhibition race held at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Being a rare night race, it's drawing a lot of attention. With huge crowds invited from outside the academy, it's bound to be a thrill."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufu... I wonder what sort of expression my beloved will make for me?
choice_data_list: (Ramonu, that's a great expression on your face.)
(Ramonu has a great look on her face.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing Mejiro Ramonu looking forward to it brings an involuntary smile to my face. However—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
We are terribly sorry...!
Tonight's event has been canceled.
choice_data_list: No way... What happened?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Due to an electrical system failure, the night lighting cannot be used.
Considering safety, we have no choice but to cancel...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
We are considering a postponement, but taking into account
every runner's schedule,
it would likely have to be held next year...
choice_data_list: ...Understood. I'll let Ramonu know as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —...Right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I thought she would be disappointed.
Yet, that was all she said in response."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later...
choice_data_list: Ramonu on the nighttime training course?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Um... Bitter Masse said she heard it from a friend.
Apparently, they "saw someone matching that description late at night."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"It's only a rumor, but...
I've heard stories of Umamusume wandering out at night
carrying a lot of anxiety and stress..."
choice_data_list: Thank you. I'll be sure to keep that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I left the break room and walked down the hall, I immediately spotted Mejiro Ramonu.
First, to see how things stand...
choice_data_list: Hey, mind if I take a look?
Hey, do you mind if I take a quick look?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Suit yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu looked no different than usual.
I peeked at the canvas from beside her, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The moment I saw that painting, the overwhelming
pressure practically took my breath away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A profound, overwhelming "energy"
radiating from the countless overlapping colors...
It was as if it were crying out for something...
choice_data_list: ...What's the title of this painting?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Nothing in particular.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I'm just drawing whatever comes to my heart.
choice_data_list: (Follow... your heart...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to draw the rest.
May I now?
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah...
Y-yeah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rumors of night walks, the sheer "pressure" radiating from the painting...
Trainer Kiryuin's words, "Burdened with anxiety and stress—", flashed through my mind.
choice_data_list: (Could she be upset that the race got cancelled...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If so, what should I do for her as her Trainer?
As I ponder over this—

choice_data_list: ...Is someone... singing...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling suspicious, I walked toward where the singing was coming from.
Though seen from a distance, the one standing there was definitely...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.
choice_data_list: Ramonu...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I followed her to the nighttime training track.
Mejiro Ramonu stood at the very front of the stands,
gazing out at the brilliantly illuminated course.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Oh.
Good day to you.
choice_data_list: What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I'm letting it acclimatize.
My skin, to the night air.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Next year, without fail,
I shall dedicate my love to that person.
choice_data_list: "That person"... Could it be about the cancelled race?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...If you cannot see them,
then let your feelings grow deeper.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"The piercing heartache, the muddy agony...
All of it is just seasoning to enhance our rendezvous..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Intertwining expectation and restlessness, I carefully brew them within my chest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
All is to melt away.
In richly ripened love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: With her—to my heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I finally felt like I understood what that drawing was.
It wasn't frustration over the race being canceled,
but a love so deep it was ready to overflow—
choice_data_list: (This is Ramonu's "longing"...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—...Fufu. I wonder
what kind of face they will make for me.
choice_data_list: If you're looking forward to it, you need to get a good night's rest.
In that case, I'll start planning counter-strategies for next year too.
In that case, I'll start planning counter-strategies for next year too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—...Fufu. I wonder
what kind of face they will make for me.
choice_data_list: If you're looking forward to it, you need to get a good night's rest.
In that case, I'll start planning counter-strategies for next year too.
In that case, I'll start planning counter-strategies for next year too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right.
Perhaps that was a bit unladylike of me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Let us keep this in mind,
so we do not get too carried away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Then, order.
Would you give me the best possible plan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"To that person of the night.
May I deliver a mellow love to them."
